what: VC/founder Sam Lessin: «I would pay a great deal for a credit card that allowed me to cancel any subscription from their integrated app rather than trying to navigate service websites». Pain: subscription cancel UX across dozens of SaaS.
why_us: Явный willingness-to-pay от платёжеспособного юзера; повторяемая боль (cancel friction) под финтех/карту или агрегатор подписок.

what: Harvest time-tracking: mass 1-star Trustpilot wave — renewal jumps $129→$1,158/yr (~794%), $180→$2,145/mo, $69→$821.50/mo (~1,091%), $2k→$22k/yr. Long-time SMBs exporting data and leaving.
why_us: Открытый churn у платящих смолл-команд; окно для cheaper time-tracking/invoicing alternative с предсказуемым ценником и лёгким импортом.
revenue: Incumbent bills $1k–$22k/yr; displaced spend is real

what: Replit Agent billing: Pro user ($100/mo) reports tasks that used to cost $5–10 now $20–70 with no realtime cost control; Jun–Jul 2026 ~$9,600 agent fees. Other reviews: $25 to watch agent fix its own mess; project $1k→$6k.
why_us: Системная боль AI-codegen platforms: unpredictable token/agent loops. Demand for spend caps, live cost meter, cheaper deterministic builders.

what: Warp.dev AI terminal: «I paid $40 for 3 minutes» — agent burned credits, hallucinated. Others: 2500 requests gone after 10 prompts; BYOK without Anthropic prompt caching → full-price Opus on large codebases.
why_us: AI-devtool pricing opacity + credit burn — та же категория, что Replit. Место для transparent usage / cached-BYOK wrapper.
revenue: $39+ surprise invoices; paid Build plan users

what: tiiny.host founder: 2019 solo launch → 2020 first $10 customer → 2021 $1k MRR → 2023 $10k → 2024 $20k MRR → today $1M+ ARR file-hosting micro-SaaS, bootstrapped after 3 failed startups.
why_us: Длинный трек simple hosting/file-share; доказанный path 0→$1M ARR без VC.

what: Career Hound job board: non-technical founder, launched ~2y ago, $25k last month. Hard paywall only: $7/wk, $20/mo, $50/yr. No free tier.
why_us: Против фримиум-догмы: жёсткий paywall на нишевом job board даёт $25k/mo.

what: Indie app for sale: launched late July 2026, $4,500 rev in ~1 month, $1,200 MRR, 200 subs, 10k downloads, 2M+ views. Asking $40k.
why_us: Свежий мультипль ~33× MRR на мобильном продукте; быстрый 0→$1.2k MRR за месяц.

what: Mobile productivity app: launched Apr 2026, $70k MRR, 250k organic downloads, UGC 300M+ views in 3.5 months. Hiring equity head of growth.
why_us: Редкий organic+UGC playbook до $70k MRR за ~5 месяцев; копируемый growth loop.

what: Whop store + Whop Ads: week 1, one morning $48 ad spend → $199 new MRR (monthly subs only), 4.15x ROAS.
why_us: Конкретный paid-acquisition loop на digital products; низкий CAC в нише Whop.

what: Solana August wrap: $143M chain app revenue (38% share), 5.2B txs; tokenized equity ATH $683M; crypto card spend $100M+; OnRe $250M RWA on Kamino; FOMO $1.2M daily revenue record.
why_us: Свежий onchain revenue map: payments/x402, RWA collateral, cards — где есть фактический yield/фи для продукта.
revenue: $143M Aug app rev on Solana; FOMO $1.2M/day

what: G2 2026 B2B AI buying: finance now leads the room («is it worth the cost?»); ~half of buyers say CFO reversed an already-approved deal in 12 months; outcome-based pricing preference 11%→23%; 70% want shorter contracts because AI pricing is unpredictable.
why_us: Макро-боль всего AI-SaaS: нужны outcome pricing, CFO-ready ROI pack, short contracts — не «seat × token».
revenue: Deals stall / CFO kill after shortlist

what: Founder shipped 7-agent AI that audits a business and outputs a scored PDF. Ran on own startup: 34/100. Price $98 per report.
why_us: Узкий AI-wrapper с фиксированной ценой (vs token burn у Replit/Warp); проверяемый формат deliverable.
